name: World Evolution Engine - Autonomous World Simulation

parameters.name: query
parameters.value: =MATCH (c:Campaign {status: 'active'}) RETURN c.id as campaignId, c.worldState as worldState, c.lastEvolution as lastEvolution

parameters.name: messages
query
parameters.value: =MATCH (c:Campaign {id: '{{ $json.campaignId }}' }) SET c.worldState = c.worldState + {{ JSON.stringify($json.world_state_updates) }}, c.lastEvolution = '{{ $json.timestamp }}', c.evolutionHistory = COALESCE(c.evolutionHistory, []) + [{{ JSON.stringify($json) }}] RETURN c

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, evolution_cycle_id: $json.evolution_cycle_id, events_processed: $json.statistics.total_events_generated, narrative_summary: $json.narrative_summary, next_evolution: $json.next_evolution_factors } }}
